ugahacks-12-2027.about:
UGAHacks 12 (2027) is the University of Georgia's annual hackathon. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at University of Georgia in Athens, GA from 2027-02-05 to 2027-02-07. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.
highlights: Build a portfolio project in one weekend
ugahacks-12-2027.eligibility: Students enrolled at a college or university (many MLH events also admit high-school students aged 18+, and some all ages 13+ with consent). Participants must follow the MLH Code of Conduct. International students may attend but must arrange their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open https://12.ugahacks.com/ and sign up for application updates or apply if the form is open
Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct
Confirm your spot when accepted and arrange your own travel unless reimbursement is offered
Attend in person and submit your project for judging
ugahacks-12-2027.costs: Free to attend; meals, snacks and workspace provided. Travel and accommodation are usually at your own cost unless the event announces travel reimbursement.

uk-bebras-challenge-2026.about:
Bebras runs every November in over 60 countries. Its puzzles teach the ideas behind computing (algorithms, logic, data structures) without needing any programming. The UK challenge, now run by the Raspberry Pi Foundation, has age categories from Kits (6–8) up to Elite (16–18).

Teachers register their school and run the challenge in class during the two-week window; top performers in older groups are invited to the Oxford University Computing Challenge (OUCC).
highlights: Top scorers invited to the Oxford Computing Challenge
uk-bebras-challenge-2026.eligibility: Pupils at UK schools (and some British schools abroad via the teacher portal), aged roughly 6–18; entered by a registered teacher.
how_to_apply: Ask a teacher to register the school at bebras.uk
Practise with past Bebras puzzles
Sit the 40-minute challenge in school between 9 and 20 November 2026

uk-chemistry-olympiad-2027.about:
Round one is a two-hour written paper of real-world chemistry problems taken in school on 21 January 2027 and marked by teachers. High scorers are invited to round two and a selection camp that picks the four students representing the UK at the IChO.

Schools register through a free Teach Chemistry account. Certificates go to all participants aged 19 and under. British international schools overseas may apply to take part after reading the eligibility FAQ.
highlights: Free, run by the Royal Society of Chemistry
Round one sat in school on 21 Jan 2027
uk-chemistry-olympiad-2027.eligibility: Students (recommended 16+) at secondary schools and colleges in the British Isles; British international schools overseas may apply by email after checking the FAQ.
how_to_apply: Ask your chemistry teacher to register the school (Teach Chemistry account) by 11 Jan 2027
Practise with past papers and worked answers
Sit round one on 21 January 2027

uklo-2027.about:
UKLO problems give a few sentences in an unfamiliar language (from Ancient Greek to Yoruba to sign languages) and ask students to deduce the grammar and translate new sentences — pure logic, no prior knowledge needed. Levels range from Breakthrough (primary) to Advanced.

Schools register on the UKLO portal and run the round-1 test in their own week; top Advanced/Intermediate scorers are invited to Round 2 (3 February 2027) and training that selects the UK team for the International Linguistics Olympiad.
highlights: No language knowledge needed — pure reasoning
Levels from primary to sixth form
uklo-2027.eligibility: Students at UK schools (and some overseas schools via the portal) entered by a registered teacher; level depends on age.
how_to_apply: Ask a teacher to register on the UKLO portal
Try past puzzles on uklo.org
Sit Round 1 in school during 11–16 Jan 2027
Qualify for Round 2 on 3 Feb 2027
uklo-2027.costs: Small per-student or per-school fee (see UKLO).

ukmt-junior-mathematical-challenge-2027.about:
The JMC is a one-hour multiple-choice paper that rewards clear thinking over memorised methods. Gold, silver and bronze certificates are awarded, and the highest scorers qualify for the follow-on rounds on 15 June 2027.

Schools (including international schools outside the UK) enter through the UKMT website.
highlights: Follow-on Junior Olympiad for top scorers
Open to UK and international schools
ukmt-junior-mathematical-challenge-2027.eligibility: Students in UK Years 8 or below (S2 Scotland, Y9 NI) or equivalent age abroad; entered by their school.
how_to_apply: Ask your maths teacher to enter via ukmt.org.uk
Practise with past papers
Sit the challenge in school on 5 May 2027
ukmt-junior-mathematical-challenge-2027.costs: Per-student entry fee paid by the school.

uncmunc-2026.about:
UNCMUNC is the collegiate Model UN of the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. Any college or university student can attend, even without a MUN team.

The conference runs 19–22 November 2026 at the UNC Chapel Hill campus, United States. It is open to college and university students — every college is welcome, no MUN team required. Working language: English.

Register via 'Register Today!' on the official site; a financial-aid page is linked from Registration. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Financial aid is available. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: 19–22 November 2026 in Chapel Hill, United States
No MUN team required; financial aid available
The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
uncmunc-2026.eligibility: Open to college and university students — every college is welcome, no MUN team required. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Register via 'Register Today!' on the official site; a financial-aid page is linked from Registration.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
uncmunc-2026.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Financial aid is available. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

undergraduate-model-eu-2027.about:
The Undergraduate Model EU, organised for 27 years by the University of Pittsburgh's European Studies Center, simulates the European Council and Council of the EU: students represent member states and negotiate EU policy. The 2027 edition is hosted by Bowling Green State University.

The conference runs 12–13 February 2027 at Bowling Green State University, 1001 E Wooster Street, Ohio, United States. It is open to undergraduate students, usually in university teams. Working language: English.

Registration opens on 19 Nov 2026 on the official page; country assignments follow on 4 Dec 2026 and optional position papers are due 28 Jan 2027. Student registration fee: $40. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: 12–13 February 2027 in Bowling Green, United States
EU Council simulation rather than UN
undergraduate-model-eu-2027.eligibility: Open to undergraduate students, usually in university teams. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Registration opens on 19 Nov 2026 on the official page; country assignments follow on 4 Dec 2026 and optional position papers are due 28 Jan 2027.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
undergraduate-model-eu-2027.costs: Student registration fee: $40. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

uni-trier-usa-canada-exchange-2027-28.about:
Universität Trier's International Office runs a joint call for exchange places at its partner universities in the USA and Canada for the 2027-28 academic year. Exchange places usually waive tuition at the host; students can apply for PROMOS funding for the study stay.

The programme list and full call (Ausschreibung) are on the International Office page; application documents must be uploaded by 15 November 2026. Open to students enrolled at Trier (international degree students at Trier included, subject to the call's rules).
highlights: Partner universities in the USA and Canada
uni-trier-usa-canada-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Students enrolled at Universität Trier (see the call for semester and language requirements).
how_to_apply: Read the Ausschreibung and programme list on uni-trier.de
Prepare documents (CV, motivation, transcripts, language certificate)
Upload via the portal by 15 Nov 2026
Apply for PROMOS funding if needed
uni-trier-usa-canada-exchange-2027-28.costs: Host tuition usually waived; living costs, travel and insurance paid by the student; PROMOS grants possible.

unicef-venture-fund-open-call.about:
The UNICEF Venture Fund invests in early-stage, open-source technology startups that can improve the lives of children and young people, in fields such as AI and data science, blockchain, extended reality, climate tech and health. Investment is equity-free, usually alongside technical mentoring, product and business support, and access to UNICEF's network.

It only accepts submissions from companies registered in UNICEF programme countries (the list is on the site; it includes many countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America, the Middle East and Eastern Europe). Startups must be willing to release their technology as open source.

Companies can send an expression of interest at any time, and UNICEF also runs thematic calls with deadlines; after an EOI there is a request for proposal stage over the following months.
highlights: For open-source tech benefiting children and youth
unicef-venture-fund-open-call.eligibility: Early-stage startups registered in a UNICEF programme country, with a working prototype and willingness to open-source their technology.
how_to_apply: Check that your company's country is on the UNICEF programme-country list.
Read the FAQ and current thematic calls.
Submit an expression of interest online.
If invited, respond to the request for proposal.

unismun-nov-2026.about:
UNISMUN is the Model United Nations programme of the United Nations International School of Hanoi, which runs high-school conferences in November and March and a separate middle-school conference. The November 2026 high-school conference takes place on 28–29 November 2026.

Committees include a UN Membership Council, the Security Council, a Reform Security Council, an Ezulwini (African Union) Security Council, BRICS and NATO, with research pages for each on the official site. Schools register interest through the 2026–27 expression-of-interest form.

A thoughtful, school-run conference with unusual committees, good for students in Vietnam and the region.
highlights: Hosted by a UN-founded international school
Unusual councils: Reform SC, Ezulwini SC, BRICS
unismun-nov-2026.eligibility: High-school students, normally via their school. English is the working language.
how_to_apply: Open mun.unishanoi.org and read the November 2026 committee pages
Ask your MUN advisor to submit the 2026–2027 expression-of-interest form
Receive country allocations
Attend 28–29 November 2026

unitar-un-young-leaders-online-training-.about:
The United Nations Young Leaders Online Training Programme is run by UNITAR's Multilateral Diplomacy division. The January 2027 edition is web-based and runs from 4 to 29 January 2027 (28 days), combining recorded and live sessions with UN and diplomacy practitioners.

It covers how the UN system works, multilateral diplomacy and negotiation, the Sustainable Development Goals, leadership, gender equality and youth engagement. It suits students and young professionals interested in international organisations; participants who complete the course receive a UNITAR certificate, and UNITAR offers an optional follow-up field visit to Geneva.

The course fee is US$750. Registration closes on 24 December 2026; further editions are planned for April, June and August 2027.
highlights: UN system, diplomacy, SDGs and leadership
unitar-un-young-leaders-online-training-.eligibility: Young people and students interested in the UN and international affairs (typically 18-35), from any country; English required.
how_to_apply: Open the UNITAR event page for the January 2027 edition.
Click 'Register' and create a UNITAR account.
Complete the registration form and pay the fee.
Register by 24 December 2026.
unitar-un-young-leaders-online-training-.costs: Course fee US$750. Optional Geneva field visit is extra.

unmun-2027.about:
UNMUN is the University of Navarra's Model UN, now in its 14th edition, held on the Pamplona campus with committees in both English and Spanish and a beginner-level English committee.

The conference runs 4–6 February 2027 at the University of Navarra campus, Pamplona, Spain. It is open to high school and university students; includes a beginner committee in English. Working language: English and Spanish.

Register via 'Inscripción' on the official site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Fees are listed in the UNMUN brochure. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: English and Spanish committees; beginner committee
The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
unmun-2027.eligibility: Open to high school and university students; includes a beginner committee in English. Working language: English and Spanish. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Register via 'Inscripción' on the official site.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
unmun-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Fees are listed in the UNMUN brochure. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

uofthacks-14-2027.about:
UofTHacks 2027 is the University of Toronto's flagship hackathon, one of Canada's largest. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at University of Toronto in Toronto from 2027-01-15 to 2027-01-17. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.
highlights: Build a portfolio project in one weekend
uofthacks-14-2027.eligibility: Students enrolled at a college or university (many MLH events also admit high-school students aged 18+, and some all ages 13+ with consent). Participants must follow the MLH Code of Conduct. International students may attend but must arrange their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open https://uofthacks.com/ and sign up for application updates or apply if the form is open
Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct

Attend in person and submit your project for judging

uottahack-9-2027.about:
uOttaHack 9 (2027) is the University of Ottawa's annual hackathon in Canada's capital. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at University of Ottawa in Ottawa from 2027-01-15 to 2027-01-17. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.
highlights: Build a portfolio project in one weekend

Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct
Confirm your spot when accepted and arrange your own travel unless reimbursement is offered
Attend in person and submit your project for judging

usa-ai-olympiad-2027.about:
USA-NA-AIO tests machine-learning theory and practical coding (Python, notebooks) following a published syllabus, with past problems online. Round 1 is a three-hour online exam; in 2026, Round 2 was held at Harvard and MIT in April and the Round 3 camp with team-selection tests at Harvard in June.

Top students represent the US at the IOAI and IAIO.
usa-ai-olympiad-2027.eligibility: K–12 students in the US and Canada.
how_to_apply: Read the syllabus and Round 1 rules
Register on usaaio.org by 31 Jan 2027
Practise with past problems
Take Round 1 on 19 Feb 2027

usaaao-2027.about:
USAAAO's first round is a proctored exam at the student's school covering astronomy and astrophysics. High scorers progress to a second round and a training camp that selects the US team for the IOAA.

Any student can sit the exam (so international students at participating schools can test themselves), but only US citizens or permanent residents can represent the US. A financial aid form is available for the fee.
usaaao-2027.eligibility: High-school students; anyone may take the exam, but only US citizens/permanent residents can join the US team. A teacher must proctor in person.
how_to_apply: Find a teacher willing to proctor
Register during the January window on usaaao.org
Take the first-round exam in February
Qualify for round two and camp
usaaao-2027.costs: About USD 30 per student in 2026 (USD 20 for schools with 5+ students); aid available.

usaebo-2027.about:
USAEBO is the only pathway for US K-12 students to Team USA at the International Economics Olympiad (IEO); in 2026 Team USA won gold, silver and bronze at the IEO in Shenzhen. Rounds cover economic theory, business case analysis and financial literacy, with a published syllabus and past problems.

Top scorers from the online rounds are invited to further rounds and team selection.
highlights: Only route to Team USA at the IEO
usaebo-2027.eligibility: K-12 students; Team USA selection limited to students eligible to represent the US (check the 2027 page).
how_to_apply: Read the 2027 USAEBO page and syllabus
Register via the portal on usaebo.org
Prepare with past problems
Sit Round 1 in spring 2027

usc-summer-programs-2027.about:
USC Summer Programs give high-school students a four-week taste of university life at the University of Southern California, with courses taught by USC faculty that earn USC college credit. Options span architecture, business, cinematic arts, communication and journalism, engineering and computer science, global studies, performing arts, pre-health, pre-law and writing.

The 2027 programme runs 21 June – 16 July in Los Angeles, with residential and commuter options and a dedicated page for international participants. Application details are released in November 2026.
highlights: USC college credit in four weeks
Wide subject range incl. film, engineering and pre-law
usc-summer-programs-2027.eligibility: High-school students (typically grades 9–12) from any country; international participants need sufficient English and a visa.
how_to_apply: Check summer.usc.edu in November 2026 for the application
Pick a programme and submit the online application with transcript
International students: follow the 'International Participants' guidance (English proficiency, visa)
Pay fees once admitted
usc-summer-programs-2027.costs: Paid: tuition plus residential fees (see 'Admission, Tuition and Fees' on the USC site).

utokyo-utrip-2027.about:
UTRIP (UTokyo Research Internship Program) brings undergraduates from universities outside Japan to the Graduate School of Science for six consecutive weeks of full-time research in physics, chemistry, biology, earth and planetary science, astronomy, mathematics or information science, plus Japanese culture activities.

Participants receive the GSS-UTRIP Scholarship: a one-off allowance on arrival (JPY 140,000 for Asia/Oceania, 160,000 for Europe/North America, 170,000 for Latin America, Africa and the Middle East) meant to cover the round-trip flight and local costs, and free housing for the 43-night stay. Students at US universities can instead apply for the FUTI award (up to USD 2,000 plus housing).
highlights: Six weeks in a University of Tokyo science lab
Scholarship of JPY 140,000–170,000 plus free housing
utokyo-utrip-2027.eligibility: Undergraduates who have completed at least one year of a bachelor's degree at a university outside Japan, in a natural science or related field, with interest in a scientific career. English test (TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent) required unless English is your first language or you have 8 years of English-medium education. Health insurance required.
how_to_apply: Check the UTRIP 'What's New' page in November 2026 for the 2027 call
Choose labs/research areas of interest
Prepare transcript, essays and English test score
Ask a recommender to submit the recommendation form (about a week after the deadline)
Submit online before the deadline (early January in 2026)
utokyo-utrip-2027.costs: GSS-UTRIP Scholarship: one-time JPY 140,000–170,000 depending on region, covering airfare and daily costs; free housing for 43 nights. Insurance is your responsibility.

utrecht-summer-school-2027.about:
Founded in 1986, the Utrecht Summer School is a partnership of Utrecht University, HU University of Applied Sciences, HKU University of the Arts and the University of Humanistic Studies, and is one of the biggest summer schools in Europe. It offers about 160 fully accredited courses taught in English across humanities, social sciences, law, business and economics, life sciences, healthcare, data science, science, engineering, art and music and languages, at bachelor's, master's and PhD level, with some international tracks in Florence, Rome, Berlin or Riga and some online courses.

Most courses award EC credits, and participants can use campus sports facilities and join a social programme (canal canoeing, pub quizzes and more). Applicants may apply for up to three courses; each course sets its own entry requirements, fee and deadline.
highlights: Bachelor's, master's and PhD levels; most give EC credits
Lively social programme in a historic student city
utrecht-summer-school-2027.eligibility: Depends on the course: most target bachelor's, master's or PhD students; some accept professionals. Open to all nationalities; English proficiency required.
how_to_apply: Browse the 2027 course list once published (early 2027)
Check the course's level, entry requirements and deadline
Apply online for up to three courses (ask approval for more)
Arrange housing via the summer school and a visa if needed
utrecht-summer-school-2027.costs: Tuition and housing vary per course and are listed on each course page; no general scholarship scheme is advertised.

uva-summer-school-2027.about:
The UvA Summer School runs a wide range of short English-taught programmes in Amsterdam each summer, from law, economics and AI ethics to psychology, urban studies, sexuality studies and creative writing, at bachelor's, master's and professional level, with a few pre-university options. Programmes typically last one to four weeks and include university housing and a social programme; online winter courses run in January.

Funding is unusually good for a European summer school: the Amsterdam University Fund travel grant (EUR 400 for non-European residents, EUR 200 for Europeans, need-based), EUR 300 partial scholarships for students at UNICA, Universitas 21 or LERU universities, and 10 full-tuition U21 scholarships with an early deadline of 7 February 2027. Only one scholarship per applicant, and not every programme participates.
highlights: Large choice of English-taught programmes in Amsterdam
Need-based AUF travel grant (EUR 400 for non-Europeans)
10 full-tuition U21 scholarships; EUR 300 network scholarships
uva-summer-school-2027.eligibility: Varies by programme: most require current bachelor's or master's enrolment (some accept professionals; pre-university programmes for secondary students). Open to all nationalities. Scholarships depend on the programme and, for U21/UNICA/LERU awards, on your home university.
how_to_apply: Choose a 2027 programme on the UvA Summer School programme list
Check on the programme page whether it offers the AUF travel grant or network scholarships
Apply online with a motivation letter (add a one-page need statement for the AUF grant)
For the U21 Full Scholarship, apply by 7 February 2027 with the scholarship addendum
Pay housing within two weeks of acceptance
uva-summer-school-2027.costs: Tuition and housing vary by programme (see each page). Scholarships: AUF travel grant EUR 200/400, UNICA/U21/LERU partial EUR 300, U21 full tuition (housing not included), alumni discount EUR 100.

vbc-summer-school-2027.about:
The VBC Summer School places students in labs at the Vienna BioCenter institutes (IMP, IMBA, GMI, Max Perutz Labs) for nine weeks of full-time research in molecular biology, neuroscience, structural biology, plant biology, computational biology and related fields. Alongside the lab project there are lectures, soft-skills sessions and a final symposium where students present their work.

It is open worldwide to students with at least two years of life-science university study and at least three months of research experience. There is no application fee. Participants get free student accommodation, a stipend of EUR 1,400 after tax and medical insurance.
highlights: Nine weeks in a leading Vienna life-science lab
Free housing, EUR 1,400 stipend and insurance
No application fee; open to students worldwide
vbc-summer-school-2027.eligibility: BA (Hons), bachelor's or master's/MSc students worldwide with at least two years of university study in a life-science-related field, at least three months of research experience, a good academic record and a high level of English.
how_to_apply: From 15 November, open the online application on the VBC training site
Rank three lab heads you would like to work with
Upload official proof of enrolment and transcripts
Start your application by 8 January and submit by 11 January 2027, 23:59 CET
Results are published by 1 March
vbc-summer-school-2027.costs: Free student accommodation, EUR 1,400 stipend (after tax) for nine weeks and medical insurance. No application fee.

vmun-2027.about:
VMUN, hosted by St. George's School, bills itself as North America's premier high-school Model UN. The 26th annual session offers 20 unique committees in downtown Vancouver.

The conference runs 29–31 January 2027 at a downtown Vancouver hotel (see the official Conference Venue page), Canada. It is open to high school students and school delegations. Working language: English.

Regular delegate registration is open; see the Registration Overview page for rounds, and the Financial Aid page if you need support. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Financial aid is available. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
vmun-2027.eligibility: Open to high school students and school delegations. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Regular delegate registration is open; see the Registration Overview page for rounds, and the Financial Aid page if you need support.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
vmun-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Financial aid is available. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

wchsmun-2027.about:
WCHSMUN is the Model UN of Western Canada High School in Calgary, one of Alberta's established school conferences.

The conference runs 2–3 April 2027 at Western Canada High School, 641 17 Ave SW, Calgary, Canada. It is open to high school students. Working language: English.

Register via the official site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
wchsmun-2027.eligibility: Open to high school students. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Register via the official site.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
wchsmun-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

web-summit-vancouver-2027-startups.about:
Web Summit Vancouver is the North American edition of Web Summit, one of the world's largest tech conferences, held on 25-28 May 2027. Its startup programme (ALPHA/BETA tiers) lets selected early-stage companies exhibit for a day, take part in investor and mentor meetings, and attend all conference sessions.

Selected startups can also apply for PITCH, the on-stage startup competition, and impact or women-led startups may qualify for discounted or sponsored packages.

Startups apply online through 'Apply for our startup program'; accepted companies pay a discounted package fee that includes tickets for the team.
highlights: Exhibit to investors, media and partners
Discounted packages; women-founder and impact support
web-summit-vancouver-2027-startups.eligibility: Early-stage startups from any country (typically pre-seed to Series A).
how_to_apply: Open the Web Summit Vancouver startup page.
Submit the startup application.
If accepted, choose and pay for a package.
Prepare your booth and optionally apply for PITCH.
web-summit-vancouver-2027-startups.costs: Startup packages are paid (discounted vs. regular tickets); travel and accommodation are the team's own.

wehack-2027.about:
WEHack 2027 is UT Dallas's hackathon for women and gender minorities. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at UT Dallas in Richardson from 2027-04-10 to 2027-04-11. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.
highlights: Build a portfolio project in one weekend
how_to_apply: Open https://www.wehackutd.com/ and sign up for application updates or apply if the form is open
Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct
Confirm your spot when accepted and arrange your own travel unless reimbursement is offered
Attend in person and submit your project for judging
wehack-2027.costs: Free to attend; meals, snacks and workspace provided. Travel and accommodation are usually at your own cost unless the event announces travel reimbursement.

west-coast-model-eu-2027.about:
West Coast Model EU is a two-day simulation of EU decision-making hosted by the University of Washington's EU Center, in which university teams represent EU member states.

The conference runs 5–6 March 2027 at the University of Washington, Seattle, United States. It is open to students of participating, registered universities (teams register through their school). Working language: English.

Participating universities register by 15 Nov 2026 via the official page; students join through their university's team. Registration details and a special hotel rate (Graduate by Hilton Seattle) are on the official page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: EU decision-making simulation on the US West Coast
Registration details and a special hotel rate (Graduate by Hilton Seattle) are on the official page
west-coast-model-eu-2027.eligibility: Open to students of participating, registered universities (teams register through their school). Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Participating universities register by 15 Nov 2026 via the official page; students join through their university's team.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
west-coast-model-eu-2027.costs: Registration details and a special hotel rate (Graduate by Hilton Seattle) are on the official page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

wichacks-2027.about:
WiCHacks 2027 is RIT's hackathon for women and non-binary students. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at Rochester Institute of Technology in Rochester from 2027-02-27 to 2027-02-28. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.
highlights: Build a portfolio project in one weekend
how_to_apply: Open https://wichacks.io/ and sign up for application updates or apply if the form is open
Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct
Confirm your spot when accepted and arrange your own travel unless reimbursement is offered
Attend in person and submit your project for judging
wichacks-2027.costs: Free to attend; meals, snacks and workspace provided. Travel and accommodation are usually at your own cost unless the event announces travel reimbursement.

women-techmakers-ambassadors-2027.about:
Women Techmakers is Google's programme for visibility, community and resources for women in technology. Ambassadors are volunteers worldwide who organise events and workshops (for example International Women's Day events), mentor others and speak publicly, supported by Google with a knowledge hub, content and a global peer network.

The programme suits students and professionals in tech who want to build leadership and community-organising skills; men and allies can support events, but the focus is on advancing women.

Google states that applications are currently closed and expected to open in May; you log activities in the Advocu platform once accepted.
women-techmakers-ambassadors-2027.eligibility: Community leaders, students and professionals in technology who support women in tech; any country.
how_to_apply: Check the Women Techmakers Ambassadors page in May 2027.
Prepare examples of your community or event work.
Submit the ambassador application.
Once accepted, run activities and log them in Advocu.

world-diplomats-istanbul-2027.about:
World Diplomats runs international MUN-style diplomacy conferences in several cities; the Istanbul edition takes place on 1–4 February 2027.

The conference runs 1–4 February 2027 at venues in Istanbul, Türkiye. It is open to participants aged 8–35 of any nationality. Working language: English.

Register via 'Register Now' for the Istanbul edition on the official site. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: Open to ages 8–35 regardless of nationality
The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
world-diplomats-istanbul-2027.eligibility: Open to participants aged 8–35 of any nationality. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Register via 'Register Now' for the Istanbul edition on the official site.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
world-diplomats-istanbul-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

world-diplomats-singapore-2026.about:
World Diplomats is a global UN-simulation platform that runs conferences in several cities. Its Singapore 2026 edition takes place on 3–6 December 2026 under the agenda 'Reimagining Global Governance, Protecting Human Rights, Peace, and Public Health in an Era of Uncertainty'.

Committees are grouped by age (middle school 8–13, high school 14–18, university 18–28, alumni 29–35). Packages include committee sessions, study guides, a certificate, ceremonies with dinners, a cultural performance and social activities.

An option for students who want an international conference with a social programme in Singapore; compare the cost with school-hosted MUNs first.
highlights: Age-grouped committees from middle school to alumni
Dinners, cultural night and scavenger hunt included
world-diplomats-singapore-2026.eligibility: Anyone aged 8–35, any nationality; English is the working language.
how_to_apply: Open worlddiplomats.org/Singapore
Choose a package under Pricing & Details
Register and pay online
Prepare with the background guides and attend 3–6 December 2026
world-diplomats-singapore-2026.costs: Basic package GBP 339 (regular price GBP 549) plus a 7% platform fee, per the official Singapore page; higher packages add more; flights and hotel extra.

wudc-2027-ottawa.about:
WUDC brings together hundreds of two-person teams and adjudicators from universities worldwide for nine preliminary rounds followed by elimination rounds, including English as a Second Language (ESL) and English as a Foreign Language (EFL) categories.

Students usually attend as part of their university debating society after internal trials. Contact your society early about selection, registration fees and travel funding.
wudc-2027-ottawa.eligibility: University students representing their institution's debating society, as two-person teams or as adjudicators.
how_to_apply: Join your university debating society
Take part in its WUDC trials
Society registers teams and judges on the official Tabbycat site
Arrange travel and visa for Canada
wudc-2027-ottawa.costs: Team and judge registration fees (covering accommodation and meals) plus travel; many universities subsidise.

wyd-seoul-2027-volunteers.about:
World Youth Day (WYD) is the international gathering of young people founded by Pope John Paul II; WYD Seoul 2027 runs 3–8 August 2027 and organisers expect around 500,000 participants and roughly 30,000 volunteers. Short-term volunteers of the Local Organizing Committee serve on site during the event in roles such as pilgrim services, logistics, venues, language support and medical teams.

The volunteer programme starts one week before the main event (from 27 July 2027) with training and a Volunteer Commissioning Mass, and volunteers are expected to be in Seoul from about 26 July to 9 August. The process is: online application, online training, interview, selection, then choosing and paying for a Volunteer Package that includes insurance, a transport card, volunteer kit, accommodation and meals.

It is open regardless of nationality, religion or disability, and is a rare chance to work inside one of the largest youth events in the world, in an international team, with an official certificate of service.
highlights: One of the largest international youth events in the world, in Seoul (3–8 August 2027)
Open to any nationality and religion; communicate in Korean, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese or Italian
Volunteer Package includes accommodation, meals, transport card, insurance and kit
wyd-seoul-2027-volunteers.eligibility: Born on or before 31 December 2008 (Korean Youth Protection Act); any nationality, religion or disability; able to communicate in at least one official WYD language (Korean, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese or Italian); must take part in all training from 27 July 2027. A recommendation letter from a Catholic priest or religious (same form for all religions) and ID are required; applicants who need a Korean visa must upload it.
how_to_apply: Read the volunteer page and FAQ on wydseoul.org.
Register in the WYD Seoul 2027 Volunteer Registration System ("Apply as a short-term volunteer").
Fill in your profile, skills and preferred service areas; upload ID and the recommendation letter.
Complete the online training and interview.
If selected, choose a Volunteer Package and pay the contribution, then arrange visa and travel.
wyd-seoul-2027-volunteers.costs: Selected volunteers pay for a Volunteer Package (amount published in the registration system) covering accommodation, meals, insurance, transport card and volunteer kit. International travel and visa are at your own cost. Long-term international volunteers (6+ months, separate track) receive accommodation and partial meal and transport support.

yale-summer-session-2027.about:
Yale Summer Session offers Yale College courses for credit taught by Yale faculty, in New Haven, online and in hybrid formats, plus the Yale Writers' Workshop, an English Language Institute and a Conservatory for Actors. Visiting college students and international students take the same courses as Yale undergraduates and receive a Yale transcript; qualified high-school students can apply through the pre-college track.

In 2027 Session A runs 31 May – 2 July and Session B 5 July – 6 August. Applications open on 11 January 2027. Yale lists tuition, fees and a page on financial assistance.
highlights: Real Yale College courses and transcript
yale-summer-session-2027.eligibility: Visiting undergraduates, international students and qualified pre-college students (check the pre-college page for age/grade rules). English proficiency required for non-native speakers.
how_to_apply: Browse 2027 courses on summer.yale.edu
Choose your student type (visiting international, pre-college, etc.)
Apply online from 11 January 2027 with transcripts and English test if required
Check the financial assistance page
Pay tuition and housing after admission
yale-summer-session-2027.costs: Paid: per-course tuition plus housing/dining for residential students (see 'Tuition and Fees'). Limited financial assistance.

yale-young-african-scholars-2027.about:
Yale Young African Scholars (YYAS) is run by Yale University's Global Scholars team for academically talented African secondary-school students. In 2027 it offers two options, and students join one: an Online College Prep Workshop (via Zoom) or a Residential Leadership Summit in Rwanda.

The curriculum covers academic skills, university admissions guidance (including applying to universities abroad), career pathways and leadership, and connects participants with a network of young leaders across Africa and YYAS alumni.

There is no tuition for either programme. Early Action closed on 20 October 2026; the Regular Decision deadline is 20 January 2027, with decisions by 20 March 2027.
highlights: No tuition; run by Yale University
Residential summit in Rwanda or online workshop
yale-young-african-scholars-2027.eligibility: Citizens or permanent residents of an African country (refugees living in Africa also eligible), aged about 16-17, currently in grade 10 or 11 at a school in Africa, able to study in English.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the YYAS site.
Create an account on the Yale Global Scholars application portal.
Complete essays and school information.
Submit by 20 January 2027 (Regular Decision).
yale-young-african-scholars-2027.costs: No tuition for either programme; check the FAQ for travel support to the residential summit.

ycp-hacks-2026.about:
YCP Hacks 2026 is a college-level hackathon at York College of Pennsylvania. It is an official Major League Hacking (MLH) 2027-season member event, held in person at York College of Pennsylvania in York, PA from 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-08. Participants form small teams (typically up to four; check the event rules), attend workshops and talks, and present a working prototype to judges at the end.

Food, workspace, Wi-Fi, swag and mentoring are provided free of charge. Beginners are welcome: MLH events run introductory workshops and expect many first-time hackers. Applications are handled on the event's own website; spots are limited and usually confirmed a few weeks before the event.

Hackathons are one of the fastest ways to build a portfolio project, meet engineers from sponsoring companies and practise teamwork under time pressure.
highlights: Build a portfolio project in one weekend
ycp-hacks-2026.eligibility: Students enrolled at a college or university (many MLH events also admit high-school students aged 18+, and some all ages 13+ with consent). Participants must follow the MLH Code of Conduct. International students may attend but must arrange their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open https://ycphacks.io/ and sign up for application updates or apply if the form is open
Form a small team or join one at the event
Complete the application and accept the MLH Code of Conduct
Confirm your spot when accepted and arrange your own travel unless reimbursement is offered
Attend in person and submit your project for judging
ycp-hacks-2026.costs: Free to attend; meals, snacks and workspace provided. Travel and accommodation are usually at your own cost unless the event announces travel reimbursement.

yfu-argentina-julia-horn-scholarship-202.about:
The Julia Horn Scholarship from YFU Argentina covers 50% of a one-year exchange in Germany (programme value 7,250 USD), departing August 2027 and returning June 2028. The family pays the other half plus passport, visa, travel to Buenos Aires, personal spending and school materials.

It is for Argentine secondary students born between 30 March 2009 and 30 July 2012 with good grades who could not afford the full programme. Registration runs 2 October 2026 - 4 January 2027 and the digital application folder is due 19 January 2027; interviews run from late January to mid-February and the winner is announced on 5 March 2027.
highlights: 50% scholarship for a year in Germany
yfu-argentina-julia-horn-scholarship-202.eligibility: Argentine secondary-school students born 30 Mar 2009 - 30 Jul 2012, good academic record, financial need.
how_to_apply: Register via the form on viajar.yfu.org.ar/julia (2 Oct 2026 - 4 Jan 2027)
Complete the digital application folder by 19 Jan 2027
Interview between 26 Jan and 16 Feb 2027
Winner announced 5 Mar 2027
yfu-argentina-julia-horn-scholarship-202.costs: 50% of the 7,250 USD programme; family pays the rest plus passport, visa and personal costs.

yfu-austria-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Austria offers school exchanges of a year, semester, trimester or a few months in about 35 countries, from Argentina, Japan and India to the USA, Canada and South Africa, plus talent programmes (music, sports, dance, arts, nature, fashion, multilingual).

Applications are open for departures in 2027 or 2028, after the winter or summer holidays. The fee includes flights, insurance, seminars, host-family and school placement and a 24-hour emergency line. Partial scholarships (including the Weltendecker scholarship) support families with low incomes and must be requested before signing the contract.
yfu-austria-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Students in Austria aged about 12-20 depending on the programme.
how_to_apply: Pick a country and programme on schueleraustausch.yfu.at
Apply online
Request a partial scholarship before signing the contract
Interview and preparation seminars
yfu-austria-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per country (includes flight, insurance, seminars, placement); partial scholarships for low-income families.

yfu-belgium-flanders-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Vlaanderen sends Flemish secondary students on exchanges with host families in 33 countries: 6 in South America, 3 in North America, 16 in Europe, 7 in Asia and 1 in Oceania.

For summer departures (June-September 2027) the registration deadline is 1 March 2027, or 1 February 2027 for Australia, Thailand, Japan and Finland; winter departures (January-March) close on 1 August. Starting a file costs 75 euros, followed by a 20% deposit of the programme price after about two weeks.
how_to_apply: Read destinations on uitwisseling.yfu.be
Register by 1 Mar 2027 (1 Feb for Australia, Thailand, Japan, Finland)
Pay the 75 euro file fee and 20% deposit
Selection and preparation
yfu-belgium-flanders-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme price per country (YFU price list); 75 euro file fee and 20% deposit.

yfu-bulgaria-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Bulgaria sends Bulgarian students aged 14-17 on a full school year, semester or summer programme with a volunteer host family in countries such as France, Germany, Belgium (Wallonia), Switzerland, Austria, Italy, Hungary, Finland, Ecuador, the USA, China and Australia.

After an information meeting YFU contacts the family to confirm participation and discuss how the fee will be covered, including scholarship and funding options. Applications are handled on a rolling basis.
highlights: Destinations in Europe, the Americas, China and Australia
how_to_apply: Attend a YFU Bulgaria information meeting
Apply via yfu.bg/how-to-apply
Discuss funding/scholarship options with YFU
Interview and preparation
yfu-bulgaria-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination (see yfu.bg/whatsincluded); scholarship/funding options discussed after the info meeting.

yfu-chile-beca-abierta-2027-28.about:
YFU Chile's Beca Abierta de Intercambio gives full (100%) scholarships for a school year abroad to Chilean secondary students with financial need and a special talent (sport, music, olympiads, debate, volunteering). The 2026 edition offered two places, Germany and Hungary, covering return flights from Santiago, visa support, health insurance, orientations, host family, board, school enrolment and support; students paid passport, travel to Santiago, medical exams and about USD 120 a month in personal costs.

Requirements in 2026: average grade of 6.5+ over the last 2.5 years (no subject under 5.0), at most in 3.º medio, intermediate-to-advanced English and documented need; applicants upload 13 documents to Google Drive, then sit an online English test and virtual interview. The 2026 call closed on 17 December 2025; the next call for 2027-28 departures is expected around November-December 2026 - check yfu.cl or email becas@yfu.cl.
highlights: For talented students with financial need
yfu-chile-beca-abierta-2027-28.eligibility: Chilean secondary students (at most 3.º medio) with high grades, intermediate-to-advanced English, financial need and a demonstrable talent.
how_to_apply: Watch yfu.cl/becas-y-descuentos for the 2027-28 call (expected Nov-Dec 2026)
Gather the 13 documents (grades, socioeconomic report, letters, video)
Share your Drive folder with becas@yfu.cl by the deadline
Take the online English test and virtual interview
yfu-chile-beca-abierta-2027-28.costs: Full scholarship: flights, visa support, insurance, host family, school, orientations. Student pays passport, travel to Santiago, medicals and ~USD 120/month personal costs.

yfu-czech-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Czech Republic sends Czech students on study stays with host families, for example in Uruguay, Germany, Austria, Chile and the USA (USA programme USD 12,700-15,600; Germany 174,000-254,000 CZK on the 2026 price list).

The YFU scholarship fund (financed by 3% of programme fees and donations) and the Czech-German Future Fund give partial scholarships, deducted from the price, based on family income, siblings, assets and the programme price; up to 50,000 CZK has been offered for Uruguay and Chile. The scholarship application must be in by the programme deadline. Recurring application windows: USA 15 January - 15 March, Austria 20 September - 2 March, Uruguay 30 October - 20 March.
highlights: Destinations incl. USA, Germany, Austria, Uruguay, Chile
yfu-czech-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Students living in the Czech Republic (age by destination); scholarship applicants submit parents' payslips and income statement and explain their need.
how_to_apply: Send the preliminary application on yfu.cz
Pass the YFU interview
Submit the scholarship form with income documents by the programme deadline
Sign the contract and prepare
yfu-czech-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme price per destination; partial scholarships from the YFU fund and Czech-German Future Fund.

yfu-denmark-exchange-2027-28.about:
YFU Danmark sends Danish young people aged 14-18 on exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools; departures are in March, July, August and September depending on the country, and students usually learn their destination in June.

For most countries the application deadline is 1 March; YFU advises applying early because medical and school paperwork takes time. Prices are on the YFU price list (with an all-inclusive price), and online information evenings are held on 17 November and 8 December 2026.
how_to_apply: Attend an online info evening (17 Nov or 8 Dec 2026)
Apply at udveksling.yfu.dk/ansoeg before 1 March 2027
Submit doctor and school paperwork
Learn your destination in June
yfu-denmark-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme price per destination (udveksling.yfu.dk/prisliste); financing information on the YFU site.

yfu-estonia-scholarships-2027-28-winter.about:
YFU Eesti sends Estonian students aged 14-18 on exchange years with host families in countries such as Japan, Argentina, Brazil, France and Paraguay. Donor-funded scholarships help young people who could not otherwise afford the year.

About 15 one-time grants of 2,000-3,000 euros are awarded per year in two rounds (1 Oct - 15 Nov 2026 and 1 Feb - 14 Mar 2027), only for the year programme. You must have passed the YFU selection day, the contract interview and fundraising training; priority goes to families with limited means and large families outside Tallinn and Tartu. Send the application form and a motivation video to taotlused@yfu.ee; shortlisted students are interviewed.
highlights: Priority for low-income and regional families
yfu-estonia-scholarships-2027-28-winter.eligibility: Students in Estonia accepted to a YFU exchange-year programme (passed selection day and contract interview).
how_to_apply: Pass YFU selection and the contract interview
Download the scholarship form from yfu.ee
Record a motivation video
Email both to taotlused@yfu.ee by 15 Nov 2026
Attend the interview if shortlisted
yfu-estonia-scholarships-2027-28-winter.costs: Programme fee; grant of 2,000-3,000 euros deducted from it.

yfu-finland-exchange-year-2027-28.about:
Youth For Understanding Finland is a non-profit exchange organisation placing Finnish students with volunteer host families and local schools in North America (USA, Canada), Latin America (Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Ecuador, Mexico, Paraguay, Uruguay), about 15 European countries, and Australia, South Africa, South Korea, Japan, China and Thailand.

Applications for the 2027-28 school year and the autumn 2027 semester are open from March 2026 until March 2027 (they close roughly six months before departure); spring 2028 semester applications run until September 2027. Applicants attend an interview. YFU Finland also awards a few partial scholarships each year (4,000 and 3,000 euros); the 2027-28 round closed in August 2026.
highlights: Volunteer host families and local schools
yfu-finland-exchange-year-2027-28.eligibility: Students living in Finland, about 15-18 at departure (varies by country).
how_to_apply: Choose a destination on yfu.fi
Submit the online application at yfu.fi/hae-vaihto-oppilaaksi
Interview with YFU
Sign the contract and attend preparation
yfu-finland-exchange-year-2027-28.costs: Programme price per destination (see yfu.fi country pages).
